ucdp.notes: The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) on June 20 claimed that its intelligence wing, TIA, identified and targeted an individual named Jamshed in an ambush in Quetta District of Balochistan, reports Frontier Files.
ucdp.source_text: "SATP,2026-06-20,The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) on June 20 claimed that its intelligence wing, TIA, identified and targeted an individual named Jamshed in an ambush in Quetta District of Balochistan, reports Frontier Files."
